summary_claims.claim: Private Members' Bill presented under the Ten Minute Rule by Alex Sobel MP; long title: prohibit development, deployment and operation of artificial superintelligence systems and establish monitoring and control powers
summary_claims.locator: Bills API, bill 4288 longTitle; bill types id 5

scope.note: Private member's bill with little chance of passing; the existing scope_note is kept. Its clause that the bill lacks government support rests on secondary reporting, not on a stored official file.

note: Rests only on the UK Parliament Bills API (host not on the official-sites list), so quotes count as secondary and the level is C by script; the API is run by Parliament and a human may add the host. It confirms title, sponsor, Commons origin, Ten Minute Rule type, first reading 8 September 2026, second reading listed 13 November 2026, not an Act, not withdrawn. A search shows the second reading has not yet taken place. The official_identifier 'Bill 4288 (Session 2026-27)' is not supported by the stored files (4288 is the database ID; sources disagree on a printed bill number); the run leaves it unchanged and the extractor's open question covers it.
